name: f3-timed-numeric-mldr
cmd: set -euo pipefail; bun recovery-input/materialize.ts; bun recovery-input/compose.ts numeric; bun numeric-input/pilot-source.ts; result=0; bun f3-input/timed-pilot.ts > timed-f3.log 2>&1 || result=$?; cat timed-f3.log; test "$result" -eq 0; bun numeric-input/pilot-source.ts timed-f3.log; bun f3-input/audit-pilot.ts timed-f3.log --strict-window --require-timed-window
